coverage_gaps.topic: Toan bo feature Ask for Review: documented nhung CHUA live-verify qua UI thuc
coverage_gaps.note: Moi claim trong shard nay (KB-001..KB-023) hoan toan dua tren tai lieu/spec ticket (QVD-171/173) qua DOC-09, KHONG dua tren bat ky quan sat runtime nao. Lan thu live-verify duy nhat (2026-09-14, store test-vl-1) bi chan TRUOC KHI toi duoc overlay: AI Offer Assistant (dependency bat buoc de trigger overlay nay) bi fully disabled tren Shopify development store ('Not available on development stores'). Day la hard UI-level gate KHONG lien quan toi chinh feature Ask for Review. Ca overlay flow (ca 2 nhanh), terminal-event exclusivity, va moi edge case o DOC-09 deu chua duoc UI-confirm. Backend storage/metrics (QVD-173) duoc tai lieu ghi la 'Done' tren branch feature/ai-offer-review-trigger-analytic nhung khong co evidence doc-lap nao xac nhan da deploy/hoat dong dung. feature-profile-builder/checklist-builder can danh dau toan bo oracle cua feature nay o muc BASELINE/can live-verify, khong coi day la da UI-confirmed.
